page.overview:
Who is Seance Dog?

Seance Dog is an in-universe fictional comic book character seen in Invincible.

Seance Dog is character in a comic book series read and favored by Mark Grayson and Kyle.

At one point, Mark was reading a comic book about the character in his bathroom until his mother barged in looking for soap which irritated Mark.

Shortly after Mark arrived at college, he opted to throw his collectible action figures of Seance Dog and other such characters in the dumpster but had a change of heart about the former.
